LESSON: OUR SCHOOL • MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES • SAFETY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social Environment
Topic 1.4: Our School • Main physical features • Safety
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Our School • Main physical features • Safety, part of Social Environment in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do you identify your way to school? 2. How can you be safe while coming to school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Our School • Main physical features • Safety together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: Teamwork, as learners role play on safety measures to take on their way to school

● Digital Literacy: Interaction with digital technology, as learners play educative digital games on locating main features between their

home and school.

● Creativity and imagination: Originality, as learners draw and colour the main physical features between home and school.

● Self-efficacy: The skill of knowing my home and school, as learners identify general features between their home and school.

Values:
● Unity: Learners enrich cooperation as they display team spirit during playing of educative games on locating main features between

their home and school.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Disaster risk reduction: Safety at home and school is developed as learners acquire safety awareness during role play on safety measures

on their way to school and back.

Link to other learning areas:

Creative Activities: learner relates to the skill of drawing and coloring as they draw and colour physical features between home and school.

Suggested Learning Resources

Digital devices, crayons, colour pencils, pencils, pictures, local environment, internet sources, adapted learner’s book,
